source.meaning: Moody's seasoned Baa corporate bond yield minus10-year Treasury yield,percentage points. Long-maturity investment-grade credit proxy,not option-adjusted high-yield spread.
source.source_change: FRED notes that the Treasury input changed to direct US Treasury data beginning2019-06-21; retain this historical provider-definition caveat.
source.license: Proprietary underlying data. Internal research only; do not publish or redistribute the raw observations,aligned values or rolling credit features.
source.high_yield_access_limit: The originally considered ICE high-yield OAS has only3years on FRED beginningApril2026. Do not bypass the restriction,use unauthorized mirrors or shorten formal evaluation windows.

methodology.hypothesis: Credit-market risk may add information not represented by a moving-average price gate. Compare a fixed level-only defense with a fixed early-recovery rule; do not fit thresholds or tune the earlier rejected strategies.
methodology.base: Reuse the existing frozen static70%equal-four-factor equity/30%GLD target for98%invested capital. Use the same253-observation prehistory and monthly decisions as the evaluated control.
methodology.level_condition: At a completed month end, risk-on means the latest safely available BAA10Y is strictly below the median of its last252alignedNYSE-session values,including that available value. Equality is risk-off.
methodology.recovery_condition: Only the second candidate also permits risk-on when the safely available BAA10Y is strictly below its value21NYSE sessions ago,even if the level remains elevated. This is a predetermined monthly compression rule,not a fitted recovery threshold.
methodology.risk_off: Remove the original70%equity sleeve and hold its weight in actual BIL; retain the original30%gold sleeve without increasing it. When equity is enabled,all four existing factor funds receive identical original family budgets.
methodology.availability: Reuse the unchanged align_observations helper: each raw observation becomes usable at the close of the secondNYSEsession strictly after its date; carry only the last actual observation while it is at most7calendar days old. No unlimited forward-fill or same-date macro use.
methodology.vintage_limits: A current FRED historical download is not ALFRED vintage proof or exact original intraday publication timestamps. The explicit two-session lag is conservative but cannot establish that no historical value was revised.
methodology.interpretation: BAA10Y compares20-plus-year corporate bonds with10-year Treasuries and includes duration,liquidity and quality effects. It is not a pure default-risk or high-yield OAS factor. This is a risk-input experiment on four existing economic families,not a new independent alpha source.
methodology.execution: Same formal10y/5yaccounts,USD10,000fresh capital,2%target idle cash,USD1orders,next-open5bpbase and one-extra-session20bpstress. Versioned cash-funded accounting and independent bt; original Sharpe/SPY/15%drawdown goals unchanged.
methodology.selection: Proposed after106completed configurations on exposed history. Only these two fixed hypotheses; no parameter grid,retrospective date exception or independent-holdout claim. The prior22candidate statistical diagnostic does not cover these new candidates.
